description: Reverify one exact permitted offer and issue a single-use tracked buying link to the authorized caller. Requires separate commerce permission and exact source, canonical product and explicit variant selection. Can contact the offer verifier and retailer redirects. Hand the returned URL to the shopper unchanged with affiliate disclosure; do not open or preview it. No purchase occurs. May return 503 when disabled.

variant_id.description: Exact variant UUID or explicit null for a nonvariant source

name: get_buy_link
title: Issue a tracked buying link
